items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: 25k:$625 | 50k:$1,250 | 100k:$2,500 | 150k:$3,750. Exceeding it immediately breaches the account.

items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: 25k:$1,250 | 50k:$2,500 | 100k:$3,500 | 150k:$5,000. Trails at EOD. Locks at Starting Balance + $100 after first payout.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: No single day's profit may exceed 40% of cycle total. Not a breach; continue trading until ratio drops below threshold.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: Minimum 1 trade per rolling 7-day period. Contact support for vacation pauses to avoid breach.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: Strictly prohibited ±5 min around Red Folder events. Clear all orders ±2 min for all news. News trades cannot be sole method to pass eval.

items.label: CME Price Limit
items.detail: Trading within 2% of CME daily price limit is prohibited to protect against extreme volatility gaps.

items.label: Risk/Reward Ratio
items.detail: Stop loss must not exceed 5x profit target. Adjusting stops to widen risk is forbidden.

items.label: Stop Loss Policy
items.detail: Every trade must open with a defined stop loss. Trading without SL or using DD as a stop = gambling & breach.

items.label: Automation & Scalping
items.detail: Bots/AI fully banned. >200 trades/day & microscalping (<5 pts/seconds) prohibited. Semi-automated allowed with manual oversight.

items.label: Martingale & Hedging
items.detail: Permitted if within margin limits & contract caps. Inconsistent sizing to recover losses is reviewed & restricted.

items.label: Trading Hours
items.detail: Auto-close at 16:10 EST daily. Does not count as breach. Weekend/Overnight holds allowed per CME schedule.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Keep 100% of first $15,000 profit. All subsequent profits split at 90% to trader / 10% to firm.

items.label: Frequency & Conditions
items.detail: Requires 5 net-positive trading days. Minimum withdrawal: $500. Processed ≤48h via RiseWorks.

items.label: Payout Targets
items.detail: 1st payout: 6% of starting balance. 2nd & beyond: 4% per cycle. Resets after each request.

items.label: Payout Caps
items.detail: 25k:$750 | 50k:$1,000 | 100k:$2,000 | 150k:$3,000 per request. Caps lift after consistent performance review.

items.label: Available Balances
items.detail: Starting balance matches eval size. No activation fee. One-time payment model.

items.label: Max Accounts
items.detail: Hold up to 3 funded accounts simultaneously. Exceeding requires ongoing eval fees.

items.label: KYC & Compliance
items.detail: Verified ID, PoA, & AML screening required via Veriff before first payout. Restricted jurisdictions apply.
